transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Saturday, October 31. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Cargo ship stranded in Pakistan for months, sailor's kin high and dry. Vedansh Mishra, a three-year-old, frequently asks about his father, Vineet, who is stranded in Karachi, Pakistan. Vineet has been unable to leave the cargo ship since April, with his family seeking help from politicians. Despite appeals to government officials, the family has yet to achieve a resolution in bringing him home. Communication with Vineet is limited due to poor network connectivity and ongoing ship conditions. Activist Arun Ferreira's arrest illegal, give him rupees 2 lakh: Bombay HC. The Bombay High Court has mandated that the Maharashtra government compensate activist Arun Ferreira with rupees 2 lakh. This ruling was based on the violation of Ferreira's fundamental rights under Articles 21 and 22, as he was arrested without valid identification and was not informed of the reasons for his detention. Elon Musk shares 'whole schedule' on how he spends time with his 14 children. Elon Musk recently disclosed details regarding his co-parenting schedule for his 14 children. He clarified that his five older children are adults living independently. Musk sees his kids with Claire every other week and his children with Shivon every few days. Contrary to claims, Musk stated that his arrangement is not corporate-like but personal. A mother who had to quit her rupees 50 LPA job, now changing chess scene in North India. After leaving her rupees 50 LPA corporate career to support her daughter Shivika's chess ambitions, Nidhi Bhasin Rohilla discovered gaps in Delhi's chess ecosystem. She set out to build what was missing, creating an academy, tournaments, and communities for players across ages and abilities. Today, her initiatives span eight states, championing accessibility, inclusion and a culture where chess thrives beyond ratings, titles and competition. Indiana landlord's $6,200 award cut to $2,400 over missing damage list. An Indiana landlord who won $6,200 from a former tenant over unpaid rent and apartment damage has had the award reduced to $2,400. In an October 29 ruling, the state appeals court found that the landlord had failed to provide the tenant with a written list of damages as required by law. The court allowed the unpaid rent claim but rejected the additional cleaning and repair costs. How Isro's NVS-03 launch will revive NavIC, boost military independence. The successful night launch of Isro's navigation satellite NVS-03 carrying an indigenously-manufactured atomic clock along with procured (foreign) atomic clocks on Friday will make India's indigenous satellite navigation system NaVIC or desi GPS up and running again. Total construction ban in Delhi-NCR from Nov 5 to 20. The national capital region will implement a complete ban on construction and demolition activities from November 5 to 20. This measure is part of a broader initiative to combat rising winter pollution levels. Union environment minister Bhupender Yadav confirmed that there would be no rollback of existing vehicle entry restrictions. Additionally, swift actions will target non-conforming industries and pollution hotspots in the region. 'India's self-reliance in critical technologies': PM Modi on Isro's NVS-03 success. Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Saturday congratulated Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) scientists and engineers following the successful launch of the GSLV-F18 mission carrying the NVS-03 navigation satellite, saying the mission would strengthen India's indigenous satellite navigation system, NavIC. Father's death, a promise and Worlds gold: Manisha Bhanwala's story. Manisha Bhanwala defeated American Abigail Nette 8-6 in a thrilling comeback victory in the final to become the first Indian woman wrestler to win a World Championships gold. But behind this historic achievement was a personal story of loss, family sacrifices and a promise she had made to herself. With 11 more questions, Census 2027 population enumeration phase to be of record 50 days. The population enumeration phase of Census 2027 will last longer than in past census exercises, with its duration spanning nearly one-and-a-half months from Jan 10 to Feb 28, including the 15-day self-enumeration window, as against the earlier Phase-2 duration of 20 days, conventionally running from Feb 9-28. Patrick Stewart dies at 86, survived by wife Sunny Ozell and family. Patrick Stewart, who died at 86, was married three times, including to musician Sunny Ozell, and had two children and four grandchildren. While he found lasting companionship in his third marriage, the actor spoke candidly about his strained relationship with his children, admitting that his dedication to acting had often come before his responsibilities as a father.

Sebi imposes rupees 1 crore fine on CDSL for multiple compliance lapses. Markets regulator Sebi on Friday imposed a penalty of rupees 1 crore on Central Depository Services (India) Ltd (CDSL) for multiple compliance lapses, including failure to communicate reasons for rejection of pledge requests to the depository participants (DPs) of both the pledgor and pledgee and shortcomings in disaster recovery drills. CDSL has been directed to pay the penalty within 45 days, failing which recovery proceedings may be initiated. In its 102-page order, Sebi said CDSL had violated several regulatory requirements during FY2023-24, following an inspection of its operations. The violations included failure to communicate reasons for rejection of pledge requests to the depository participants of both the pledgor and pledgee, non-compliance with prescribed procedures for handling Client Unpaid Securities Accounts (CUSA), inadequate measures to prevent unauthorised data transmission and shortcomings in disaster recovery operations. A Kerala consumer commission ordered IRCTC to refund a passenger Re 1 withheld from a cancelled ticket, with 9 percent interest, rupees 100 compensation and rupees 3,000 in legal costs. transcript.text: Next, science and technology. Apple Intelligence is finally coming to China with iOS 27.3. Apple will launch Apple Intelligence in China with iOS 27.3, the company announced on its Chinese newsroom website, as reported by MacRumors. The Apple Intelligence features will be available first in an iOS 27.3 beta that's set to launch on November 4th, with a full iOS 27.3 release scheduled for December. This launch doesn't bring Nvidia weighs playing the cosigner for Nscale's AI data center in West Virginia. When investors get nervous about AI spending, it helps to have the chipmaker that sells the chips offer to cosign the loan. Astronauts just gave the International Space Station a powerful upgrade. Two astronauts completed a 7-hour, 11-minute spacewalk to install a new solar array on the International Space Station, bringing NASA one step closer to a major power upgrade. Once the final array is installed on November 5, the station will have up to 30 percent more available power, supporting critical operations and its eventual controlled deorbit. PUBG fans alert! How the battle royale game became a global gaming phenomenon as Netflix develops live-action series. From its early access launch to becoming one of the world's most recognised battle royale games, PUBG has transformed online gaming. With Netflix developing a live-action adaptation, the game's journey and global popularity are back in focus. Exclusive details about Akai's MPC Sample Key. Akai teased its new MPC Sample Key on Instagram earlier this week, and said it plans to open-source its software so the modding community can hack it to their hearts' delight. While there's no word yet on when the device will launch or how much it will cost, The Verge has received exclusive images of Salesforce's M and A spree continues with a reported $375M deal for defense tech startup Rune. The AI logistics startup will bolster the CRM giant's Missionforce defense platform. The asteroid killed the dinosaurs. Why did crocodiles survive?. Scientists may have solved a 66-million-year-old mystery: how crocodiles survived the asteroid that wiped out the dinosaurs. A sweeping analysis of fossils and ancient climates suggests that their preference for warm environments placed them in tropical refuges that remained habitable even after the catastrophic impact. As an increasing number of AI assistants flood the market, the founder of Ollie, an assistant that respected its users' privacy, says it will be shutting down in a week. A computer scientist breaks through a limit that stood since 1996. A computer scientist has achieved a breakthrough in a nearly 25-year-old problem involving how computers calculate distances across enormous networks. The new algorithm delivers more reliable estimates for closely connected points without sacrificing speed, overcoming a longstanding limitation of earlier methods. Its secret lies in a smarter way of sampling network connections at multiple scales. AU Small Finance Bank data breach: Hackers threaten to leak Aadhaar, PAN and customer records. AU Small Finance Bank is investigating a potential data leak involving its Salesforce platform after hackers claimed access to sensitive customer records. The allegedly exposed information includes Aadhaar, PAN, KYC documents, CIBIL scores, bank statements and loan records. The biggest names in AI are backing a new way to opt out of scraping. OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, and Anthropic say they will adopt a new standard that publishers can use to opt out of being scraped by AI, as reported earlier by Search Engine Roundtable. With this control, publishers can apply their AI training preferences across multiple AI companies, instead of setting them individually. The shared "policy token" signal Intel's stock crashes, knocking $12B from government's stake. Intel is being hurt by PC sales as the AI industry gobbles memory and other components causing PC prices to rise. Type 2 diabetes breakthrough as 54 percent achieve remission in just 6 months. A promising new study suggests that more than half of younger adults with type 2 diabetes could achieve remission in just six months through a combination of a low-calorie diet and structured exercise. Researchers found that 54 percent of participants under age 45 who followed an intensive diet and exercise program achieved remission, compared with just 4 percent receiving usual care. AI robotics may need 10 million hours of interaction data to reach production-level capabilities: Goldman Sachs. General-purpose artificial intelligence (AI) robotics could require an estimated 10 million hours of high-quality physical interaction data to reach production-level capabilities, highlighting the challenges in achieving commercial viability, even as technological progress in the sector is projected to be two to four times faster than the historical pace of autonomous driving technology, according to a report by Goldman Sachs. Google's satellite AI server transmits its first response to Earth. Google's AI chip-equipped satellite has generated its first response from space. In a blog post on Friday, Google says it successfully booted up the satellite's Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), allowing the on-board Gemma 4 model to follow through on a prompt to create a haiku about being in space: Blue marble below Data streams in Anthropic expected to receive high 'junk' rating from credit agencies following IPO, FT report says. Blackstone's forecast is just a prediction, but naturally, a high junk rating would make it more difficult and costlier for Anthropic to raise the money to keep funding its massive spending that has undergirded its business. Scientists discover mysterious seahorse lookalikes that no one has ever seen alive. Scientists have discovered that three bizarre deep-sea fish that look exactly like seahorses actually belong to a separate evolutionary group, proving that nature created the same unusual body shape more than once. Nicknamed "sea muppets," these elusive creatures are known from just seven specimens, and no one has ever seen one alive. India ranks second globally in AI-powered shopping, 76 percent consumers use AI tools: McKinsey. India is among the world's leading markets for AI-powered shopping, with 76 per cent of consumers using artificial intelligence tools to search for products, compare choices or make purchase decisions, according to a report by McKinsey, which highlighted the growing shift towards AI-led commerce. A startling new study suggests that venomous snakebites are killing far more people worldwide than official statistics indicate, with an estimated 274,000 to 513,000 deaths every year. Researchers found that as many as 7 million people could suffer snake envenoming annually, while more than 800,000 survivors are left with long-term disabilities.

transcript.text: Turning to the big national stories. 'Dedication and ingenuity of our space scientists': PM Modi hails ISRO after successful GSLV-F18 launch carrying NVS-03. The population enumeration phase of Census 2027 will last longer than in past census exercises, with its duration spanning nearly one-and-a-half months from Jan 10 to Feb 28, including the 15-day self-enumeration window, as against the earlier Phase-2 duration of 20 days, conventionally running from Feb 9-28. UK govt announces new 'safe and legal' routes for refugees in India to resettle in UK. In a bid to dissuade asylum-seekers from arriving in Britain on the backs of lorries or via small boats, the UK home office has announced three new "safe and legal" sponsorship routes for refugees in India and six other countries to come to the UK and claim asylum. Bhutan GLOF creates new lake downstream, raises fears of secondary hazards. A glacial lake outburst flood (GLOF) originating in Bhutan, which prompted an alert across parts of Assam and West Bengal on Friday, has led to the formation of a new temporary lake downstream, raising concerns about a possible secondary hazard. Isro's GSLV-F18/NVS-03 mission successful: Next-generation navigation satellite placed in orbit; NavIC constellation gets a boost. GSLV-F18 carrying 2,250kg next-generation navigation satellite -- NVS-03 -- lifted off from the second launch pad at the Satish Dhawan Space Centre (SDSC-SHAR) in Sriharikota at 11.51pm on Friday, as scheduled. Around 18 minutes later, NVS-03 satellite was placed in a geosynchronous transfer orbit (GTO) of 37,023km apogee and 170km perigee. Ritabrata Banerjee has responded strongly to Abhishek Banerjee's warning issued to West Bengal police officers. He accused Abhishek of arrogance and urged the state government to take action against him. Additionally, Ritabrata challenged Abhishek to visit a temple alone without security, disputing his claim of public support. Abhishek had recently expressed concerns about police targeting TMC workers and claimed to have a list of implicated officers. J and K cops bust terror financing syndicate, 10 held. J and K Police Friday said they have busted a terror financing module and arrested 10 suspects from different parts of the union territory.
